title: Ob-havo va fasllar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ob-havoni va haroratni ingliz tilida aytasiz, "What's the weather like?" deb so‘raysiz hamda shahringizdagi ob-havoni to‘rt fasl uchun tasvirlab berasiz.

scenes.title: Ob-havo haqida gaplashamiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n oltinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda hafta kunlari, oylar va sanalarni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa har kuni ishlatiladigan mavzu: ob-havo va fasllar. Inglizlar suhbatni ko‘pincha ob-havodan boshlashadi, shuning uchun bu mavzu juda foydali. Dars oxirida har bir fasl uchun shahringizdagi ob-havoni ingliz tilida aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson sixteen! Last time we learned days, months and dates. Today we will talk about the weather and the seasons.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n oltinchi darsga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar hafta kunlari, oylar va sanalarni o‘rgandik. Bugun ob-havo va fasllar haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Ob-havo gapida It
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “Havo issiq” deymiz, bu yerda “havo” gapning egasi. Inglizcha gap esa egasiz bo‘lmaydi, ob-havo haqida gapirganda esa ega o‘rnida “it” turadi. Bu “it” hech narsani anglatmaydi, u faqat o‘rinni to‘ldiradi, shuning uchun tarjima qilinmaydi. Formula: it, is, sifat. “It is hot” — havo issiq. Og‘zaki nutqda qisqartirib “It's hot” deymiz.
scenes.say: In English, we talk about the weather with the word it. It is hot. It is cold. In speech we say it's: It's hot. It's cold.
scenes.say_uz: Inglizchada ob-havoni it so‘zi bilan aytamiz. It is hot. It is cold. Og‘zaki nutqda it's deymiz: It's hot. It's cold.

scenes.title: It va fe’l: yomg‘ir, qor
scenes.say_native: Yomg‘ir va qor haqida gapirganda fe’l ishlatamiz. O‘zbekchada “yomg‘ir yog‘yapti” deymiz, inglizchada esa “It's raining”. Bu yerda “rain” o‘zi fe’l, “yog‘moq” degan alohida so‘z kerak emas. Fe’l oxiriga “ing” qo‘shiladi va bu hozir, aynan shu payt yog‘ayotganini bildiradi. Hozirgi davomli zamonni keyinroq to‘liq o‘rganamiz, bugun bu ikki iborani tayyor qolip sifatida eslab qoling.
scenes.say: It's raining. It's snowing. We use ing because it is happening now.
scenes.say_uz: It's raining. It's snowing. Ing qo‘shamiz, chunki bu hozir bo‘layotgan hodisa.

scenes.title: Ob-havo so‘zlari
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy ob-havo so‘zlarini birga ko‘rib chiqamiz. Sunny, ya’ni quyoshli. Cloudy, bulutli. Rainy, yomg‘irli. Windy, shamolli. Snowy, qorli. Foggy, tumanli. Misollarga e’tibor bering: ikkita sifatni “and” bilan bog‘lash mumkin, masalan “cloudy and windy”. “Today” va “this morning” kabi vaqt so‘zlarini gap oxiriga qo‘ysak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy, snowy, foggy. It's sunny today. It's cloudy and windy. It's foggy this morning.
scenes.say_uz: Quyoshli, bulutli, yomg‘irli, shamolli, qorli, tumanli. Bugun havo quyoshli. Havo bulutli va shamolli. Bugun ertalab havo tumanli.

scenes.title: Sifat qanday yasaladi
scenes.say_native: Bu sifatlar otga “y” qo‘shib yasalgan: rain, rainy; cloud, cloudy; wind, windy. Ba’zilarida oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: sun, sunny; fog, foggy. Bu qisqa unlidan keyingi bitta undosh uchun qoida. Ikki shakl ham to‘g‘ri: “It's rainy” va “It's raining” deyish mumkin. Birinchisi havoning umumiy holatini, ikkinchisi hozir yog‘ayotganini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Add y to the noun: sun, sunny. Rain, rainy. Cloud, cloudy. Wind, windy. Fog, foggy. You can say it's rainy or it's raining.
scenes.say_uz: Otga y qo‘shing: sun, sunny. Rain, rainy. Cloud, cloudy. Wind, windy. Fog, foggy. It's rainy ham, it's raining ham deyish mumkin.

scenes.title: Egani tashlab ketmang
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: o‘zbekchadagi kabi egani tashlab ketish. “Is hot today” deyish noto‘g‘ri, chunki gapda ega yo‘q. Rus tilida ham “Идёт дождь” deyiladi va ega yo‘q, shuning uchun bu xato ko‘p uchraydi. Ikkinchi xato: “Today is raining”. “Today” bu yerda ega bo‘la olmaydi, chunki bugun yog‘maydi, yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Doim “It” bilan boshlang: It's hot. It's raining.
scenes.say: Do not forget it. Not: is hot today. Say: it's hot today. Not: today is raining. Say: it's raining today.
scenes.say_uz: it ni unutmang. Is hot today emas. It's hot today deng. Today is raining emas. It's raining today deng.

scenes.title: Inglizchaga o‘giring
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz mashq qiling. Men o‘zbekcha ibora aytaman, siz uni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting. Esda tuting: har safar “It” bilan boshlaysiz. Birinchi: havo quyoshli. Ikkinchi: yomg‘ir yog‘yapti. Uchinchi: havo shamolli. To‘rtinchi: qor yog‘yapti.
scenes.say: Say in English. One: the weather is sunny. Two: it is raining. Three: the weather is windy. Four: it is snowing.
scenes.say_uz: Inglizchada ayting. Bir: havo quyoshli. Ikki: yomg‘ir yog‘yapti. Uch: havo shamolli. To‘rt: qor yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “It's sunny”. Ikkinchi: “It's raining”. Uchinchi: “It's windy”. To‘rtinchi: “It's snowing”. Agar birinchi so‘zingiz “It” bo‘lgan bo‘lsa, eng muhim qoidani o‘zlashtirdingiz. Yana bir bor e’tibor bering: sifat bilan “is” keladi, yomg‘ir va qor bilan esa fe’l va “ing” keladi.
scenes.say: It's sunny. It's raining. It's windy. It's snowing.
scenes.say_uz: Havo quyoshli. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti. Havo shamolli. Qor yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: Weather so‘zining talaffuzi
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim so‘z “weather”, talaffuzi “ue-za”. Bu yerdagi “th” jarangli: tilingizning uchi tishlar orasida turadi va ovoz titraydi. “Z” ga o‘xshab eshitiladi, lekin til tishlar orasida bo‘ladi. Oxirgi “er” yengil “a” ovozi, ingliz tilida “r” aytilmaydi. “Sunny” so‘zida “u” o‘zbekcha “u” emas, “a” ga yaqin: “sa-ni”. Urg‘u hammasida birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
scenes.say: Weather. The th is voiced. Sunny. Cloudy. Foggy. The stress is on the first syllable.
scenes.say_uz: Weather. Th jarangli. Sunny. Cloudy. Foggy. Urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.

scenes.title: To‘rt fasl
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rt fasl bilan tanishamiz. Spring — bahor, summer — yoz, autumn — kuz, winter — qish. Faslni aytganda “in” predlogini ishlatamiz: “in spring”, “in summer”, “in winter”. Predlog bir xil, “in” bilan, shuning uchun uni eslab qolish oson. Muhimi, o‘zbekchada “yozda” deb qo‘shimcha qo‘shamiz, inglizchada esa uning o‘rniga “in” so‘zi alohida turadi.
scenes.say: Spring, summer, autumn, winter. We say in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter. It's hot in summer.
scenes.say_uz: Bahor, yoz, kuz, qish. In spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter deymiz. Yozda havo issiq.

scenes.title: Autumn va fall
scenes.say_native: Kuz uchun Britaniya inglizchasida “autumn” ishlatiladi, Amerikada esa asosan “fall” deyiladi. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Britaniya varianti “autumn” so‘zida oxirgi “n” harfi aytilmaydi: “o-tem”. Yozilishida bor, talaffuzida yo‘q. Bu ko‘plab o‘zbek o‘quvchilari xato qiladigan joy. Amerikacha “fall” bilan ishlatilsa, odatda “in the fall” deyiladi.
scenes.say: In British English we say autumn. The n is silent. In American English people usually say fall.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniya inglizchasida autumn deymiz. N aytilmaydi. Amerika inglizchasida odatda fall deyiladi.

scenes.title: Daraja va harorat
scenes.say_native: Haroratni aytganda “It's” va raqam, so‘ng “degrees” ishlatamiz. “It's twenty-five degrees” — yigirma besh daraja. “Degrees” har doim ko‘plikda, bittadan boshqa hamma songa. Manfiy haroratni “minus” bilan aytamiz: “minus five”. Britaniyada va O‘zbekistonda Selsiy ishlatiladi. Amerikada esa Farengeyt. Shuning uchun amerikalik “It's eighty” desa, bu issiq kun, sovuq emas.
scenes.say: It's twenty-five degrees. It's minus five. The UK uses Celsius. The USA uses Fahrenheit.
scenes.say_uz: Havo yigirma besh daraja. Minus besh. Britaniya Selsiydan foydalanadi. AQSH Farengeytdan foydalanadi.

scenes.title: Issiq va sovuq darajalari
scenes.say_native: Haroratni ifodalovchi besh so‘z bor, ular taxminan shunday tartibda. Hot — issiq. Warm — iliq, yoqimli. Cool — salqin. Cold — sovuq. Freezing — juda sovuq, muzlatadigan sovuq. Ular qat’iy chegaralar emas, odamlar turlicha his qiladi. Muhimi, “warm” yaxshi ma’noda iliq, “hot” esa ba’zan juda issiq. “Cool” esa salqin va noqulay emas, yoqimli.
scenes.say: Hot, warm, cool, cold, freezing. Warm is nice. Hot is very warm. Freezing is very, very cold.
scenes.say_uz: Hot, warm, cool, cold, freezing. Warm yoqimli. Hot juda iliq. Freezing juda-juda sovuq.

scenes.title: Degree va have
scenes.say_native: Uch xato tez-tez uchraydi. Birinchisi: “It has thirty degrees”. Rus tilidagi “на улице тридцать градусов” kabi ega yo‘q gaplardan kelib chiqadi. Inglizchada “have” ishlatilmaydi, “is” ishlatiladi. Ikkinchisi: “degree” bir xil qoladi, lekin bir martadan ortiq bo‘lsa “degrees” bo‘ladi. Uchinchisi: fe’lni tushirib qoldirish. To‘g‘risi: “It's thirty degrees”.
scenes.say: Not: it has thirty degrees. Say: it's thirty degrees. Remember the s on degrees.
scenes.say_uz: It has thirty degrees emas. It's thirty degrees deng. Degrees dagi s ni unutmang.

scenes.title: Haroratni ayting
scenes.say_native: Har bir harorat uchun to‘liq gap tuzing va mos so‘zni qo‘shing. Masalan, “It's twenty degrees, it's warm”. Birinchi: o‘ttiz ikki daraja. Ikkinchi: yigirma ikki daraja. Uchinchi: sakkiz daraja. To‘rtinchi: minus to‘rt daraja. Hot, warm, cool, cold yoki freezing ichidan eng mosini tanlang.
scenes.say: Thirty-two degrees. Twenty-two degrees. Eight degrees. Minus four degrees. Say a full sentence for each.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz ikki daraja. Yigirma ikki daraja. Sakkiz daraja. Minus to‘rt daraja. Har biri uchun to‘liq gap ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. O‘ttiz ikki daraja: “It's thirty-two degrees, it's hot”. Yigirma ikki daraja: “It's twenty-two degrees, it's warm”. Sakkiz daraja: “It's eight degrees, it's cold” yoki “cool” desa ham bo‘ladi, bu sizning hissingizga bog‘liq. Minus to‘rt: “It's minus four, it's freezing”. Agar so‘zlaringiz biroz farq qilgan bo‘lsa, muhimi gap tuzilishi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: It's thirty-two degrees. It's hot. It's twenty-two degrees. It's warm. It's eight degrees. It's cold. It's minus four. It's freezing.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz ikki daraja. Issiq. Yigirma ikki daraja. Iliq. Sakkiz daraja. Sovuq. Minus to‘rt. Dahshatli sovuq.

scenes.title: Qaysi fasl?
scenes.say_native: Oylar va fasllarni bog‘laymiz. Britaniyada fasllar mana shunday bo‘linadi. Har bir oylar guruhiga mos faslni ayting va “in” bilan to‘liq gap tuzing, masalan “June is in summer”. Birinchi guruh: iyun, iyul, avgust. Ikkinchi: dekabr, yanvar, fevral. Uchinchi: mart, aprel, may. To‘rtinchi: sentabr, oktabr, noyabr.
scenes.say: Which season? June, July, August. December, January, February. March, April, May. September, October, November.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi fasl? Iyun, iyul, avgust. Dekabr, yanvar, fevral. Mart, aprel, may. Sentabr, oktabr, noyabr.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Iyun, iyul, avgust — yoz, “summer”. Dekabr, yanvar, fevral — qish, “winter”. Mart, aprel, may — bahor, “spring”. Sentabr, oktabr, noyabr — kuz, “autumn”. Bu bo‘linish Britaniya uchun odatiy. Boshqa mamlakatlarda, shuningdek, janubiy yarim sharda fasllar boshqacha vaqtga to‘g‘ri keladi, lekin bizga hozir shu yetarli.
scenes.say: June, July, August: summer. December, January, February: winter. March, April, May: spring. September, October, November: autumn.
scenes.say_uz: Iyun, iyul, avgust: yoz. Dekabr, yanvar, fevral: qish. Mart, aprel, may: bahor. Sentabr, oktabr, noyabr: kuz.

scenes.title: What's the weather like?
scenes.say_native: Ob-havo haqida so‘rash uchun asosiy savol: “What's the weather like?”, ya’ni “Ob-havo qanday?” Bu yerda “like” so‘zi “yoqtirmoq” degani emas, “qanday” degan ma’noni beradi. Savolga javob “It's” bilan boshlanadi: “It's sunny”. Savol oxirida “like” albatta qolishi kerak. Oxiriga “today” yoki “in London” kabi so‘z qo‘shsak, savol aniqroq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: What's the weather like? It's sunny. We say like at the end of the question.
scenes.say_uz: Ob-havo qanday? Havo quyoshli. Savol oxirida like deymiz.

scenes.title: Boshqa savollar
board: Is it raining?  Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
What's the weather like in London?
scenes.say_native: Xuddi shu ma’noda “How's the weather?” deb ham so‘rasa bo‘ladi. Bu yerda “like” kerak emas. Ha-yo‘q savol uchun “is” ni “it” oldiga o‘tkazamiz: “Is it cold?” Javobi qisqa: “Yes, it is” yoki “No, it isn't”. O‘zbekchada “sovuqmi?” deb oxirgi qo‘shimcha bilan so‘raymiz, inglizchada esa so‘zlar tartibini o‘zgartiramiz. Shahar nomini “in” bilan qo‘shamiz: “in London”.
scenes.say: How's the weather? Is it cold? Yes, it is. No, it isn't. What's the weather like in London?
scenes.say_uz: Ob-havo qalay? Havo sovuqmi? Ha, shunday. Yo‘q, unday emas. Londonda ob-havo qanday?

scenes.title: Savolda xato
scenes.say_native: Savol bering paytida ikki xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi: “How” va “like” ni birga ishlatish. “How's the weather like” noto‘g‘ri. Yo “How's the weather?” deysiz, yo “What's the weather like?”. Ikkinchisi: so‘z tartibi: “What the weather is like” gapdagi kabi aytilgan. Savolda “is” oldinga chiqadi: “What is the weather like”, qisqartirib “What's”.
scenes.say: How or what ... like, but not both. What's the weather like? How's the weather?
scenes.say_uz: How yoki what ... like, ikkalasi birga emas. What's the weather like? How's the weather?

scenes.title: Savol va javob
scenes.say_native: Rasm tasavvur qiling: Annaning shahrida besh daraja issiq va qor yog‘yapti. Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Annaning shahrida ob-havo qanday? Ikkinchi: yomg‘ir yog‘yaptimi? Uchinchi: havo iliqmi? Ikkinchi va uchinchi savolda qisqa javob bering: ha yoki yo‘q va yordamchi fe’l.
scenes.say: Anna's city: five degrees, snowing. One: what's the weather like? Two: is it raining? Three: is it warm?
scenes.say_uz: Annaning shahri: besh daraja, qor yog‘yapti. Bir: ob-havo qanday? Ikki: yomg‘ir yog‘yaptimi? Uch: iliqmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “It's cold and it's snowing”. Ikkinchi: “No, it isn't. It's snowing”. Yomg‘ir emas, qor yog‘yapti. Uchinchi: “No, it isn't. It's cold”, chunki besh daraja iliq emas. Qisqa javobda “No, it isn't” deymiz, “No, it not” emas. Qisqartirmasdan “No, it is not” ham to‘g‘ri, lekin biroz keskin eshitiladi.
scenes.say: It's cold and it's snowing. No, it isn't. It's snowing. No, it isn't. It's cold.
scenes.say_uz: Havo sovuq va qor yog‘yapti. Yo‘q. Qor yog‘yapti. Yo‘q. Havo sovuq.

scenes.title: Telefon suhbati
board: Anna: What's the weather like in Tashkent?
Aziz: It's sunny and warm. 22 degrees.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Anna Londonda, Aziz Toshkentda. Ular telefonda gaplashmoqda. Anna Azizdan ob-havo haqida so‘raydi. Diqqat bilan eshiting: Londonda ob-havo qanday, Toshkentda necha daraja va Toshkentda shamol bormi. Avval faqat tinglang, keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Aziz: Hi, Anna! What's the weather like in London? Anna: It's cloudy and cold. It's eight degrees. What's the weather like in Tashkent? Aziz: It's sunny and warm. It's twenty-two degrees. Anna: Lucky you! Is it windy? Aziz: No, it isn't. It's a lovely day.
scenes.say_uz: Aziz: Salom, Anna! Londonda ob-havo qanday? Anna: Havo bulutli va sovuq. Sakkiz daraja. Toshkentda ob-havo qanday? Aziz: Havo quyoshli va iliq. Yigirma ikki daraja. Anna: Omadingiz bor ekan! Shamol bormi? Aziz: Yo‘q. Ajoyib kun.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslang va uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Londonda ob-havo qanday edi? Ikkinchi: Toshkentda necha daraja edi? Uchinchi: Toshkentda shamol bormi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan bering, masalan “It's ...”. Yodingizdan ayting, shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Question one: what's the weather like in London? Question two: how many degrees is it in Tashkent? Question three: is it windy in Tashkent?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savol: Londonda ob-havo qanday? Ikkinchi: Toshkentda necha daraja? Uchinchi: Toshkentda shamol bormi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Londonda havo bulutli va sovuq edi, sakkiz daraja. Toshkentda yigirma ikki daraja, quyoshli va iliq. Shamol yo‘q edi: “No, it isn't”. Dialogda “Lucky you” iborasini ham eshitdingiz, u “omadingiz bor ekan” degani. Annaga Toshkentdagi ob-havo yoqdi. Bunday iboralar nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: It's cloudy and cold. It's twenty-two degrees. No, it isn't. Lucky you means you are lucky.
scenes.say_uz: Havo bulutli va sovuq. Yigirma ikki daraja. Yo‘q. Lucky you - omadingiz bor degani.

scenes.title: Ob-havoni baholash
scenes.say_native: Ob-havoni baholash uchun yana sifatlar kerak. Qarama-qarshi juftliklar: hot va cold, wet va dry. “Wet” — ho‘l, nam, yomg‘irli, “dry” — quruq. Yaxshi ob-havo uchun “nice”, “lovely”, “beautiful” deymiz. Yomon ob-havo uchun “terrible” yoki “horrible”. “Lovely” britaniyaliklarning juda yaxshi ko‘rgan so‘zi, “nice” esa har kuni ishlatiladigan so‘z.
scenes.say: Hot and cold. Wet and dry. Nice, lovely, beautiful. Terrible, horrible. It's a lovely day.
scenes.say_uz: Issiq va sovuq. Ho‘l va quruq. Yaxshi, ajoyib, go‘zal. Dahshatli, jirkanch. Ajoyib kun.

scenes.title: A nice weather emas
scenes.say_native: Endi xatoni ko‘rib chiqamiz. “It's a nice weather” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “weather” oldidan “a” qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi. “The weathers are bad” ham noto‘g‘ri, chunki “weather” ko‘plikka o‘tmaydi. To‘g‘ri variant: “The weather is bad”. Eslab qoling: o‘zbekchada “ob-havolar” deyish g‘alati, inglizchada ham shunday. Bitta ob-havo bor, har doim birlikda.
scenes.say: Not: a nice weather. Say: nice weather. Not: the weathers are bad. Say: the weather is bad.
scenes.say_uz: A nice weather emas. Nice weather deng. The weathers are bad emas. The weather is bad deng.

scenes.title: Very, quite, a bit
scenes.say_native: Sifat oldiga darajani bildiruvchi so‘z qo‘ysak, ob-havoni aniqroq tasvirlaymiz. “Very” — juda, “really” ham shu ma’noda. “Quite” — ancha. “A bit” — biroz, kam. Hammasi sifatdan oldin turadi: “very cold”, “quite warm”, “a bit windy”. O‘zbekchadagi “juda” bilan bir xil tartib, shuning uchun bu qiyin emas. Faqat “a bit” iborasida “a” ni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: Very hot. Quite warm. A bit windy. It's very cold today. It's a bit cloudy.
scenes.say_uz: Juda issiq. Ancha iliq. Biroz shamolli. Bugun havo juda sovuq. Biroz bulutli.

scenes.title: Very raining emas
scenes.say_native: “Very” faqat sifat bilan ishlatiladi. “Rainy” sifat, shuning uchun “very rainy” to‘g‘ri. “Raining” esa fe’l, uning oldiga “very” qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi. “It's very raining” — jiddiy xato. Qattiq yomg‘ir yog‘ayotganini aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “It's raining a lot” yoki “It's raining hard” deng. Bu qoida qorga ham tegishli: “It's snowing a lot”.
scenes.say: Very goes before adjectives. It's very rainy. For the verb, say: it's raining a lot.
scenes.say_uz: Very sifat oldidan keladi. It's very rainy. Fe’l bilan: it's raining a lot.

scenes.title: Ob-havoga mos kiyim
scenes.say_native: Ob-havo haqida gaplashganda ko‘pincha maslahat ham beramiz. Yomg‘irli kun uchun “umbrella” — soyabon. Sovuq uchun “coat”, “hat”, “scarf”. Quyoshli kun uchun “sunglasses”. Maslahat berganda fe’lni gapning boshiga qo‘yamiz: “Take an umbrella”, “Wear a hat”. “Take” — olmoq, “wear” — kiymoq. Bunday gap buyruq emas, qisqa va samimiy maslahat.
scenes.say: Umbrella, coat, hat, scarf, sunglasses. It's raining. Take an umbrella. It's cold. Wear a hat.
scenes.say_uz: Soyabon, palto, shapka, sharf, quyosh ko‘zoynagi. Yomg‘ir yog‘yapti. Soyabon oling. Sovuq. Shapka kiying.

scenes.title: Onasi va Tom
board: Mum: It's cold today. Take your coat.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: uyda ertalab. Tom maktabga ketmoqchi, onasi uni ob-havodan ogohlantiradi. Diqqat bilan tinglang. Tom soyabon oladimi? Haroratni onasi necha daraja deydi? Tom yana nimani kiyishi kerak? Savollar dialogdan keyin beriladi.
scenes.say: Mum: Tom, it's cold today. It's seven degrees. Take your coat. Tom: Is it raining? Mum: No, it isn't, but it's very windy. Tom: OK, Mum. Mum: And wear your hat and scarf. Tom: Yes, Mum. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Ona: Tom, bugun sovuq. Yetti daraja. Paltongni ol. Tom: Yomg‘ir yog‘yaptimi? Ona: Yo‘q, lekin juda shamolli. Tom: Xo‘p, ona. Ona: Shapka va sharfingni ham kiy. Tom: Xo‘p, ona. Xayr!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: necha daraja? Ikkinchi: yomg‘ir yog‘yaptimi? Uchinchi: Tom paltodan tashqari nimani kiyadi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling. Bu savollar oddiy, o‘zingizga ishoning.
scenes.say: One: how many degrees is it? Two: is it raining? Three: what does Tom wear, besides his coat?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: necha daraja? Ikki: yomg‘ir yog‘yaptimi? Uch: Tom paltodan tashqari nima kiyadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Havo yetti daraja: “It's seven degrees”. Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgani yo‘q: “No, it isn't”, lekin shamolli. Tom paltoga qo‘shimcha ravishda shapka va sharf kiyadi: “a hat and a scarf”. Ko‘rib turibsiz, kundalik suhbatda ob-havo, harorat va maslahat doim birga uchraydi. Siz bularning hammasini endi bilasiz.
scenes.say: It's seven degrees. No, it isn't. A hat and a scarf.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti daraja. Yo‘q. Shapka va sharf.

scenes.title: Gap ohangi va urg‘u
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy gapirish uchun urg‘uni bilish kerak. Gapda eng muhim so‘z kuchli aytiladi, “it's” esa yengil. “It's HOT” — urg‘u “hot” da. “What's the WEATHER like” — urg‘u “weather” da. Savol so‘z bilan boshlansa, ya’ni “what” yoki “how” bilan, ovoz oxirida pastga tushadi. O‘zbekchada savol ohangi ko‘tarilishi mumkin, inglizchada “what” savollarida esa pastga tushadi.
scenes.say: It's HOT. What's the WEATHER like? The voice goes down at the end of a question with what.
scenes.say_uz: It's HOT. What's the WEATHER like? What bilan boshlangan savol oxirida ovoz pastga tushadi.

scenes.title: Xatoni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Endi xatolarni tuzatamiz. Uchta noto‘g‘ri gap bor. Birinchisi: “Is cold today”. Ikkinchisi: “It has twenty degrees”. Uchinchisi: “It's a nice weather”. Har birida bitta xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri gapni baland ovozda ayting. Bugungi darsda aynan shu uchta qoidani o‘rgandik, shuning uchun javob sizga tanish bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Correct the mistakes. One: is cold today. Two: it has twenty degrees. Three: it's a nice weather.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni tuzating. Bir: is cold today. Ikki: it has twenty degrees. Uch: it's a nice weather.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda ega yo‘q edi, to‘g‘risi “It's cold today”. Ikkinchi gapda “have” ning o‘rniga “is” kerak: “It's twenty degrees”. Uchinchi gapda “a” ortiqcha, chunki “weather” sanalmaydi: “It's nice weather”. Yoki “It's a nice day” deyish ham mumkin. Uchalasini ham to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi asosiy qoidalarni o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: It's cold today. It's twenty degrees. It's nice weather. Or: it's a nice day.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun sovuq. Yigirma daraja. Yaxshi ob-havo. Yoki: yaxshi kun.

scenes.title: Namuna: mening shahrim
board: In spring it's warm and green.
In summer it's hot and dry.
In autumn it's cool and rainy.
In winter it's cold and snowy.
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy vazifaga tayyorlanamiz. Mana namuna: “In spring it's warm and green. In summer it's hot and dry. In autumn it's cool and rainy. In winter it's cold and snowy.” Ko‘rib turibsiz, har bir fasl uchun bitta gap va ikkita sifat. Siz o‘zingizning shahringiz haqida shu tuzilmani saqlab, sifatlarni almashtirasiz. Haqiqiy ob-havoni tasvirlang, kitobdagini emas.
scenes.say: In spring it's warm and green. In summer it's hot and dry. In autumn it's cool and rainy. In winter it's cold and snowy.
scenes.say_uz: Bahorda havo iliq va yam-yashil. Yozda issiq va quruq. Kuzda salqin va yomg‘irli. Qishda sovuq va qorli.

scenes.title: Sizning navbatingiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z shahringizdagi ob-havoni ingliz tilida ayting. Har bir fasl uchun bitta gap tuzing: “In spring it's ...”, “In summer it's ...” va hokazo. Ikkita sifat ishlating, “very” yoki “a bit” qo‘shsangiz yanada yaxshi. Shoshilmang, har bir gapning boshida “It's” borligiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Describe the weather in your city in spring, summer, autumn and winter. Use it's and two adjectives for each season.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Shahringizdagi ob-havoni bahor, yoz, kuz va qishda tasvirlang. Har fasl uchun it's va ikkita sifat ishlating.

scenes.title: Tekshirish ro‘yxati
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshirib ko‘ring. Har bir gap “It's” bilan boshlandimi? Fasllar oldida “in” bor edimi? Ikkita sifatni “and” bilan bog‘ladingizmi? “Weather” oldiga “a” qo‘ymadingizmi? Hammasiga “ha” desangiz, bugungi maqsadga erishdingiz. Qaysi biri qiyin bo‘lsa, shu joydan darsni qayta ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Check yourself. Did you say it's in every sentence? Did you use in with the season? Did you use two adjectives?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Har gapda it's dedingizmi? Fasl bilan in ishlatdingizmi? Ikkita sifat ishlatdingizmi?

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Birinchi, ob-havo gapida har doim “it” bor: “It's sunny”, “It's raining”. Ikkinchi, fasllar: spring, summer, autumn, winter va ular bilan “in”. Uchinchi, harorat: “It's twenty-five degrees”. To‘rtinchi, savol: “What's the weather like?”. Beshinchi, sifatlar va “weather” oldida “a” yo‘qligi. Bu dars sizga kundalik suhbatni boshlash uchun tayyor iboralar berdi.
scenes.say: Today we learned it's sunny, it's raining, the seasons, degrees, and the question what's the weather like.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun it's sunny, it's raining, fasllar, darajalar va what's the weather like savolini o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: describe the weather in your city
Keyingi dars: hobbies and free time
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: shahringizdagi ob-havoni har bir fasl uchun tasvirlang. Har fasl uchun kamida ikkita gap yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting, jami sakkizta gap. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gap “It's” bilan boshlansin, harorat yoki kamida bitta sifat bo‘lsin va “weather” oldida “a” bo‘lmasin. Keyingi darsda sevimli mashg‘ulotlar va bo‘sh vaqt haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: describe the weather in your city in each season. Write or say two sentences for each season.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: shahringizdagi ob-havoni har fasl uchun tasvirlang. Har fasl uchun ikkita gap yozing yoki ayting.

homework_uz: Shahringizdagi ob-havoni har bir fasl uchun tasvirlang: har fasl uchun kamida ikkita gap yozing yoki ayting. Har bir gap It's bilan boshlansin, harorat yoki sifat bo‘lsin va weather oldida a bo‘lmasin.

quiz.why_uz: Ob-havoda “it is” ishlatiladi: It is sunny.
Ega “it” bo‘lishi va is yoki 's kerak.
What's the weather like? savolida like oxirida turadi.
Songa mos ravishda degrees ko‘plikda bo‘ladi.
Weather sanalmaydigan ot, oldiga a qo‘yilmaydi.

quiz.q: In British English, autumn is pronounced without the sound ...
It's 0°C and there is ice. It's ...

quiz.why_uz: Very fe’l bilan emas, sifat bilan keladi.
Fasllar oldida in ishlatiladi: in summer.
